title: The organization's answer to a credential request, credential-decision/1 (DEC-0111)
description: Carried in a check-in response's records.credentialDecisions. It names the credential issued by slot, provider, preset and end, never its value; the value arrives only in a fabric-credential-envelope/1. FAC-SEM-138: it answers the request it names; issued names a credential ending no later than the request asked, for its provider, and no reason; refused names a reason and no credential; pending names neither. docs/specification/credentials.md#the-decision.

by.description: who decided: an administrator, or the organization's auto-approval policy

slot.description: the credential's slot name, never its value

provider.description: the provider the credential is for, e.g. cloudflare or openrouter

preset.description: a preset the organization's issuer lists (a scope, a spend limit and its reset), by name
